name: ghidra
description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
one_liner: A free, professional-grade tool from the NSA that lets you take apart compiled software to see how it really works.
buyer: A security consultant or malware analyst who needs to reverse-engineer software but can't afford commercial tools like IDA Pro.
business_use_cases: A security firm reverse-engineers malware samples for incident-response reports instead of paying for commercial licenses.
A firmware auditor extracts and analyzes embedded-device binaries for a client security assessment.
A trainer builds a paid reverse-engineering bootcamp curriculum around this free, industry-standard tool.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid malware-analysis or firmware-security-audit services for clients, using Ghidra as the core tool.
Sell a training course or certification-prep program for reverse engineering using Ghidra.

steal_this: Launch a 'firmware security audit' freelance offer for IoT hardware startups, using Ghidra to do the actual analysis.
